title: Tesla’s $30,000 Cybercab comes with a $299 monthly catch
gist: Tesla is selling its steering-wheel-free Cybercab to select customers for $29,900, but the car will not operate without a mandatory 'autonomy subscription' starting at $299/month, which Tesla can suspend at will, with geofencing, a ban on putting it on the Robotaxi network, and transfer restrictions. The model extends automakers' push into high-margin software subscriptions, while Musk himself said the fee should be ~$115/month.
